history.summary: A very large 2260sqft 3BR at $1100 psf — ~24% below the Riversound median of $1455, the deepest PSF discount in the batch. But the $2.486M total price and reliance on Kangkar LRT only (no MRT) make it a niche, slow-moving exit. 6.5%/yr appreciation on 137 txns is good; the question is who buys a $2.5M leasehold OCR unit without an MRT.
history.rating_rationale: The cheap PSF is real but largely an artifact of size: a 2260sqft layout at $2.486M sits above the deepest buyer band ($1.8-2.5M edge) and is served only by Kangkar LRT, which thins the buyer pool versus MRT-fronting peers. For an investment hold, liquidity and yield matter more than headline PSF — and a 2260sqft unit yields poorly per dollar while appealing mainly to a narrow large-family segment. 6.5%/yr CAGR and a well-regarded 590-unit Qingjian development keep it from Avoid, but the size/price/exit profile caps it at Neutral.
red_flags: $2.486M total at the edge of/above the liquid band for OCR leasehold
Served only by Kangkar LRT — no MRT within walking distance
2260sqft is oversized for investment; weak yield-per-dollar and narrow buyer pool
Low headline PSF is driven by size, not genuine undervaluation
catalysts: Punggol Digital District / CRL lifting wider D19
Large layout appeals to multi-gen families if priced to move

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Big unit, modest rent ceiling for the area; gross yield likely under 3% on $2.486M. Tenant pool for a $5-6k Sengkang rental is thin.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 6.5%/yr resale CAGR on 137 txns is sound, but large units lag smaller ones on PSF growth and the LRT-only access limits the catalyst pass-through.
